recording.title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-04
recording.credits: Dave Usborne (transfer/mastering) | Recording credit: Gerry Olsen | Transfer/mastering credit: Dan McDonald and dusborne
recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-04 Audience Recording by Gerry Olsen. Sony TC-124 single-capstan portable cassette deck equipped with Sony F-99S One Point Stereo Dynamic Microphone IMP LOW (hand-held). 120 minute BASF normal bias tape. Lineage via Dan McDonald (droncit@yahoo.com): Master Audience Cassette->Nakamichi BX-1 (modified for flat transfer)-> Tascam DR-07MK2 (24-bit, 96kHz); DC8Forensics was used to apply the NAB curve for normal bias cassettes. Converted to 16-bit, 44.1kHz using 32-bit interpolation and a triangular high pass dither. After the NAB curve in a multifilter I applied a virtual vale and overtone generator for lost harmonics and used a channel blender to blend below 150 Hz to mono to minimize mic handling noise. Gerry Olsen Dan McDonald and dusborne

Converted to 16-bit, 44.1kHz using 32-bit interpolation and a triangular high pass dither. recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1971-02-24 7" two track BBD reel w/ Dolby A @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM501ES (beta) > PCM501ES analog out > Dolby A decoder > Apogee filter > analog in PCMF1/PCM501ES analog out > Fostex D5 @ 48 kHz > WBOTB Master DAT (DAT-1). Original WBOTB DATs procured & circulated in 1996 by Jace Crouch and Tim Deibert. Thanks to trailmix for providing the lineaged master DAT for transfer. Transfer and mastering by Chris Ladner. Jace's DAT (48 KHz) playback on Sony PCM-R500, AES digital output > Benchmark DAC1, XLR analog output > Grace Lunatec V3, sample rate at 96 KHz, AES digiout) > AES digital input, professional mode/sync - LynxTwo soundcard in E6400 dual core processor-based PC > HD as 24 bit/96 KHz WAV > Ozone 3.0 > MBIT+ dithering to 16/44.1 KHz WAV > CDWAV 1.9 (tracking) > FLAC (level 8). Recording, editing and mastering with Wavelab 5.0. All cables were Mogami Gold 0.3m pro-audio XLR cables. All components in the transfer/mastering chain were powered from a Cyberpower 1285AVR noise-attenuated uninterruptible AC power supply.

recording.title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1983-06-24
recording.credits: Recording credit: George "Fingers" Bethke | Transfer/mastering credit: John Wenzel
recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1983-06-24 Recorded by the late George "Fingers" Bethke FOB in the sweet spot as always Sennheisser 421s>Sony TCD5M>Sony TCD5M (1st gen backup copy from Justin Lee) No Dolby on master cassettes. The first gen. cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions). Transfer by Dave Cohen February 2011; additional George "Fingers" Bethke John Wenzel files tagged with Tag&Rename, checksums created with traderslittlehelper, Tagging, checksums and text February 12,2012 - John Wenzel

Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. 25 feet FOB DFC 6.5 ft stand Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1985-04-07
recording.credits: Recording credit: Dave Cohen | Transfer/mastering credit: Dave Cohen
recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1985-04-07 Just to the right of the Board Sennheisser 421s>Sony TCD5M>Sony WMD6 Maxell XLII cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. Dave Cohen Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1985-04-08 Back right corner of the Board Sennheisser 421s>Sony TCD5M>Sony WMD6 Maxell XLII cassette masters. Dolby B was NOT used on the Master Cassettes. Dave Cohen Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.title: Grateful Dead Live at Merriweather Post Pavilion on 1985-06-30
recording.credits: Recording credit: Tom Strizak | Transfer/mastering credit: Tom Strizak
recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at Merriweather Post Pavilion on 1985-06-30 Master recording by Tom Strizak (*first show with new mics) 2- Sennheiser MD441 mounted in standard stereo configuration Sony TC-D5M (dolby - On B) > TDK MA90 Cassette. Location: Taper Section on lawn slightly right of center approx. 10' back from last row of pavillion seating. This resulted in a combination of sound mainly coming directly from delay speakers which were used to propagate sound outward to the lawn area, and just a small portion of the sound coming from inside the pavillion. Tom Strizak Tom Strizak Analog Master cassette played back on Nakamichi CR-1A > Behringer XR-18 audio mixer > ZOOM H-5 digital recorder 24bit/48Khz WAV > Reaper v7.61 *DAW (final audio editing and mastering) > Audacity *DAW (tracking and conversion from WAV file to FLAC 24bit 48khz file set) > LMA for upload (*DAW = Digital Audio Worksatation)
recording.sourceChain: Master recording by Tom Strizak (*first show with new mics) 2- Sennheiser MD441 mounted in standard stereo configuration Sony TC-D5M (dolby - On B) > TDK MA90 Cassette. Location: Taper Section on lawn slightly right of center approx. 10' back from last row of pavillion seating. This resulted in a combination of sound mainly coming directly from delay speakers which were used to propagate sound outward to the lawn area, and just a small portion of the sound coming from inside the pavillion.

recording.title: Grateful Dead Live at Rubber Bowl, University of Akron on 1986-07-02
recording.credits: Recording credit: Dave Cohen | Transfer/mastering credit: Dave Cohen
recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at Rubber Bowl, University of Akron on 1986-07-02 2 Nakamichi CM100s/ CP1>Sony WMD6 Maxell XLII cassette masters. No Dolby was used on the Master Cassettes. FOB Phil's side about 35 yards from stage chest high mic stand Dave Cohen Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
recording.sourceChain: 2 Nakamichi CM100s/ CP1>Sony WMD6 Maxell XLII cassette masters. No Dolby was used on the Master Cassettes. FOB Phil's side about 35 yards from stage chest high mic stand

Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at UIC Pavilion on 1987-04-10 2 Nakamichi CM100/CP4s>Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS 90 cassettes. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. Sec. 109 Row U Seat 17 8 ft. stand. Dave Cohen and Justin Lee Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.title: Grateful Dead Live at Hampton Coliseum on 1988-03-26
recording.credits: Recording credit: Dave Cohen | Transfer/mastering credit: Dave Cohen
recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at Hampton Coliseum on 1988-03-26 2 Nakamichi CM100/CP4s 1 Nakamichi CM300/CP1 Nakamichi 550 w/Dolby B in OTS. Dave Cohen Dave Cohen Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. Dave Cohen Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.title: Grateful Dead Live at Rosemont Horizon on 1989-04-11
recording.credits: Recording credit: Justin Lee | Transfer/mastering credit: Dave Cohen
recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at Rosemont Horizon on 1989-04-11 2 Nakamichi CM300s CP4 + 1 Nakamichi CM100 CP1 Nakamichi 550>Sony TCD5M (Oade erase head removal modifications) w/Dolby B in OTS. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. . Justin Lee Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
recording.sourceChain: 2 Nakamichi CM300s CP4 + 1 Nakamichi CM100 CP1 Nakamichi 550>Sony TCD5M (Oade erase head removal modifications) w/Dolby B in OTS. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. .
recording.lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.credits: Recording credit: Dave Cohen and Justin Lee | Transfer/mastering credit: Dave Cohen
recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at The Mecca on 1989-04-15 2 Nakamichi CM300 CP4 & 1 Nakamichi CM300 CP1. Nakamichi 550>Sony TCD5M Oade Erase head removal Modification w/Dolby B. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. OTS Sec. PP Row 5 Seat 3. Dave Cohen and Justin Lee Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at The Mecca on 1989-04-16 2 Nakamichi CM300 CP4 & 1 Nakamichi CM300 CP1 w/ Nakamichi 550>Sony TCD5M Oade erase head removal Modification w/Dolby B. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. OTS Sec. PP Row 5 Seat 2 Dave Cohen and Justin Lee Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.credits: Recording credit: Dave Cohen and Justin Lee | Transfer/mastering credit: Dave Cohen

Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. Front Row of Lawn 8 foot stand Dave Cohen and Justin Lee Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.credits: Recording credit: Dave Cohen and Justin Lee | Transfer/mastering credit: Dave Cohen
recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1989-07-17 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP1's X-Y @ 90degrees w/1 Nakamichi CM300/CP1 bisecting the X-Y Pair> Nakamichi 550>Sony TCD5M (Oade erase head removal modifications) w/Maxell MX90 cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. Front Row of Lawn 8 foot stand. Dave Cohen and Justin Lee Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1990-04-01
recording.credits: Recording credit: Dave Cohen | Transfer/mastering credit: Dave Cohen
recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1990-04-01 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP4's w/1 Nakamichi CM300/CP2> Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS90 cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. OTS 8 foot stand (sec. 128 Row DD Seat 3) Dave Cohen Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
recording.sourceChain: 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP4's w/1 Nakamichi CM300/CP2> Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS90 cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. OTS 8 foot stand (sec. 128 Row DD Seat 3)
recording.lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1990-04-02
recording.credits: Recording credit: Dave Cohen | Transfer/mastering credit: Dave Cohen
recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1990-04-02 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP4's w/1 Nakamichi CM300/CP2> Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS90 cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. OTS 8 foot stand (sec. 128 Row CC Seat11) Dave Cohen Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
recording.sourceChain: 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP4's w/1 Nakamichi CM300/CP2> Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS90 cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. OTS 8 foot stand (sec. 128 Row CC Seat11)
recording.lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1990-04-03 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP4's w/1 Nakamichi CM300/CP2> Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS90 cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. OTS 8 foot stand (sec. 128 Row CC Seat 12) Dave Cohen Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
recording.sourceChain: 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP4's w/1 Nakamichi CM300/CP2> Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS90 cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. OTS 8 foot stand (sec. 128 Row CC Seat 12)
recording.lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.credits: Recording credit: Dave Cohen and Justin Lee
recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at Deer Creek Music Center on 1990-07-19 Recorded by Dave Cohen and Justin Lee 2 Nakamichi CM300 Omnis Spaced at 2 meters>Nakamichi 550 w/dolby B Maxell XLIIS90s cassettes 3/4 of the way back in OTS, DFC The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby Decoded on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions). FLAC'd using Audiofile Engineering Sample Manager. Transfer by Dave Cohen Dave Cohen and Justin Lee

recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1991-03-17 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP4s w/6" diameter plexiglass plates directly behind the rear pickups of the capsules> Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS cassette masters Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. Official Taping Section 8 Ft. Stand (Sec. 128, Row C, seat 4) . Dave Cohen Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).

recording.title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1991-03-18
recording.credits: Recording credit: Dave Cohen | Transfer/mastering credit: Dave Cohen
recording.evidence: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1991-03-18 3 Nakamichi CM300s/CP4s>Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. Official Taping Section 8 foot stand (sec. 128 Row B Seat 13) Dave Cohen Dave Cohen The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
recording.sourceChain: 3 Nakamichi CM300s/CP4s>Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. Official Taping Section 8 foot stand (sec. 128 Row B Seat 13)

Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
